versions.content: If development error detection is enabled by MemDevErrorDe- tect , the service Mem_Suspend shall check that the provided instanceId is con- sistent with the configuration. If this check fails, Mem_Suspend shall raise the develop- ment error MEM_E_PARAM_INSTANCE_ID .
